functions.name: FX_AddOriginRef
functions.evidence: Finds an origin-ref entry within 131072.0 of the given point (bumping its refcount) or appends a new entry with refcount 1; returns the table index.

functions.name: FX_ReleaseOriginRef
functions.evidence: Drops one reference of an origin-ref entry; when it reaches zero the last entry is moved into the slot and all effects that referenced the last index are re-pointed.

functions.name: FX_Noop

functions.name: FX_ClearEffects
functions.evidence: Destroys every effect in both lists (virtual deleting dtor) and zeroes the counters.

functions.name: FX_ShutdownSystem
functions.evidence: Clears all effects; with final!=0 the scheduler is also torn down and unregistered from its context slot.

functions.name: FX_Reset
functions.evidence: Clears all effects and resets the scheduler (no null check on the scheduler).

functions.name: FX_ResetBlockers
functions.evidence: Resets the blocker count.

functions.name: FX_Init
functions.evidence: Initialises the FX system for the current context: first-time counters, shuts down any old state, stores the flag, creates the scheduler (0xc bytes) and registers it.

functions.name: FxEffect_Retire
functions.evidence: Releases an effect through its vtable (+8) when requested and drops the flagged-effect counter.

functions.name: FX_RemoveFromListA
functions.evidence: Removes effect 'index' from list A: shrinks the live end, moves it out via fn_081373c6, retires it.

functions.name: FX_RemoveFromListB
functions.evidence: Same as FX_RemoveFromListA for list B.

functions.name: FX_ListFull

functions.name: FX_ReserveListB

functions.evidence: Resets the blocker count then runs UpdateFlagged (vtbl +0x1c) on flagged (0x1000) effects of lists B then A.

functions.name: FX_GetAttenuation
functions.evidence: Returns the product of blocker attenuations along the segment from 'from' to 'to' (1.0 when there are no blockers or the segment is shorter than the cvar threshold).

functions.name: FX_FreeRemovedListA

functions.name: FX_FreeRemovedListB

functions.name: FxPtrTable_Get

functions.evidence: Reads serialised effects from a message and adds them to the lists (type 1,2,3,4,5,7,9,11,12 create different effect classes; other ids are skipped). A zero type byte ends the stream.

functions.evidence: qsort comparator for draw entries: sortKey, then origin-ref rank, then sortKey2, then farther first.

functions.name: FX_CompareByDistance
functions.evidence: qsort comparator on (index, distance) pairs: larger distance first.

functions.name: FX_SortDrawList
functions.evidence: Sorts the draw list: first ranks the origin-ref entries by distance to the view origin (farther = lower rank), publishes the ranks in g_08a53cac, then qsorts the draw entries.

functions.name: FX_UpdateListA
functions.evidence: Per-frame update of list A: effects past their end time (flagged 0x400) or whose Update returns 0 are removed; finally frees the removed ones.

functions.name: FX_UpdateListB
functions.evidence: Same as FX_UpdateListA for list B.

functions.name: FX_UpdateListAFrom
functions.evidence: Updates list A from index 'start' only (no free pass; old count taken from the live end).

functions.name: FX_CollectDrawListA
functions.evidence: Appends list A effects that are not hidden to draw list A with their view distance.

functions.name: FX_UpdateListBFrom
functions.evidence: Updates list B from index 'start' only (no free pass).

functions.name: FX_CollectDrawListB
functions.evidence: Appends list B effects that are not hidden to draw list B (only when g_08a53818 is set).

functions.name: FX_DrawEffects
functions.evidence: Builds the final draw list (B entries then A entries), optionally sorts it, draws every entry (vtbl +0x14) and prints the "Active/Drawn/Scheduled FX" counters when the debug cvar is set.

functions.name: FxSpawner_ComputeOrigin
functions.signature: void FxSpawner_ComputeOrigin(struct FxSpawner *spawner, float *outOrigin, const float *base, float *axis);
functions.evidence: Computes the spawn origin of an effect element: local offset (randomised ranges, rotated by the axis unless flags2 bit 0x40), plus spherical (flag 1) or cone/disc (flag 4) random spread, optionally rebuilding the axis from the spread direction (flag 2); the result is copied or transformed to outOrigin. axis points at three consecutive vec3 (forward/right/up) that may be rewritten.

functions.name: FxSpawner_ComputeTraceOrigin
functions.signature: void FxSpawner_ComputeTraceOrigin(struct fx_primitive_s *def, const float *start, float *out, const float *base, float *axis);
functions.evidence: Origin for a traced element: without flags2 bit 8 it is a random offset (rotated by axis unless 0x80) added to base; with bit 8 a 16384-unit ray along axis from 'start' is traced, the hit position is stored in 'out' and, with bit 0x10, the scheduler is notified.

functions.name: FxSpawner_ApplyElapsed
functions.signature: void FxSpawner_ApplyElapsed(struct fx_primitive_s *def, struct Effect *e, float *pos, int msec);
functions.evidence: Advances a position by the effect's velocity for 'msec' milliseconds (only when msec > 0).

functions.name: FxSpawner_Setup
functions.signature: char FxSpawner_Setup(struct FxSpawner *s, struct Effect *e, const float *origin);
functions.evidence: Registers a freshly created effect: reserves a list slot (A when the spawner handle is set, else B), adds an origin ref, and fills the effect from the definition (time range, ids, flags, handles). Returns 0 (after leaking the origin ref) when the lists are full.

functions.name: FxEffect_ResetSortKey
functions.evidence: Resets sortKey to 0, or -1 when the effect's id40 is flagged by the FX system.

functions.name: FxSpawner_SetupSequence
functions.signature: void FxSpawner_SetupSequence(struct fx_primitive_s *def, struct Effect *e, int count, int index);
functions.evidence: Sets the animation sequence of an effect: frame chosen by def->frameMode (0 fixed, 1 random, 2 caller-supplied) and rate by def->rateMode (0 ms value, 1 frames over duration).

functions.name: FxSpawner_Randomize
functions.signature: void FxSpawner_Randomize(struct FxSpawner *s, struct Effect *e, float *a, const float *b, float *axis);
functions.evidence: Randomises an effect from its definition: per-flag random values in [0,1), ranges, spawn origin (FxSpawner_ComputeOrigin) and axis. The sixth argument is passed by the caller but unused.

functions.name: FxSpawner_Spawn
functions.signature: void FxSpawner_Spawn(struct FxSpawner *s, float *axis, const float *origin, int msec, int index);
functions.evidence: Spawns one effect (class with vtable 0x24c bytes): setup, randomise, sequence, elapsed-time advance. The object is deleted through its vtable if setup fails.

Meaning of fx_primitive_s flag bits (0x1000, 0x2000.., flags2 0x1..0x80) and of effect type ids 1,2,3,4,5,7,9,11,12 is not established.
fn_080a4116 (distance, squared or not) and the effect-list A/B split (handle set vs not) are inferred only.
